scope: Opt-in Slack agent thread continuity through native private Nexus conversations and actual SDK thread replies; broader gateway remains partial.
implemented: Explicit boolean threaded_conversations on Slack agent entrypoints; missing/false preserves legacy behavior and true on workflow targets is rejected.
Verified parent/root timestamp, signed workspace, channel, Slack sender, mapped owner, target and entrypoint revision bind private native history. Untrusted runtime session IDs are ignored.
Same thread follows server receipt order through existing sessions, runs, jobs and workspace/SQL lock. Duplicate event IDs never dispatch twice.
Two SQL controllers, file/SQL restart and stopped backup/restore retain binding/history. Archived, foreign/tampered or missing historical sessions fail rather than being silently adopted/recreated.

Versioned receipt states prevent old readers from handling pending work. Interrupted launching becomes uncertain and blocks continuation until explicit owner review/revision reset; no ambiguous action replay.
Mapping/configuration changes and project revocation suppress queued dispatch and late replies. Real SDK replies use verified parent, fixed channel and reply_broadcast:false.
Responsive entrypoint checkbox retains saved state, hides outside Slack and disables for workflow targets. Existing service worker cache advances to v58.

simulation.lost_response: Separate direct local HTTP peer applies one effect and closes response; one request, no replay.

browser.save_reopen: Disabled synthetic entrypoint changed true to false to true, saved and reopened; remained disabled. Keyboard focus checked; non-Slack control hidden.

validation.static: Affected Python lint/format, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace pass. Existing unrelated messaging formatting left unchanged.

completion_claims.scope: Recorded claim consistency only, not runtime completeness.

migration.session_metadata: Additive slack_thread_binding / nexus-slack-thread/v1, stored in existing sessions. No new authentication, scheduler or job service.
migration.uncertain_recovery: New reader startup converts interrupted slack_launching to uncertain. Inspect Activity/remote effects before saving a new entrypoint revision and sending a fresh message; old run is never replayed.
migration.downgrade: Pause opted-in entrypoints before downgrade or mixed-version deployment. Old readers ignore versioned pending receipts but do not understand the flag on fresh messages. Retain receipts/session metadata and resume with new reader after review.
migration.revision_reset: Any entrypoint save starts fresh thread history; previous owned conversations remain readable.

privacy: Separate history per Slack sender and mapped Nexus owner. Replies remain visible to Slack channel/thread members; no Slack history is fetched.
remaining: Workflow-thread semantics beyond opt-in agent conversations.
Inbound files/images and outbound artifact transfer/downloads.
Rich structured artifact replies, feedback/evaluation controls.
Task cancellation and artifact/help command interactions.
Socket Mode transport and its independent acceptance.
Independent source/invocation review for other catalog entries.
live_validation_pending: Real Slack bot scopes, account delivery/edit permissions and rate limits.
Personal HTTPS VM, physical devices and real Slack transport.
